comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically sets and locks a gripper stop; PR-2115 heats and solders a copper joint without burning flux.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual torque coupling; PR-2115 tests coordinated torch/filler placement, thermal timing, solder feeding, and safe cooling.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked angle retained through motion; PR-2115 requires sufficient solder, set joint, tools away, and no overheating or misdirected flame.
comparison.reason: The shared use of two tools does not equate mechanical counterholding with heat-process control.
